## Current starting point — 11 September 2026

Part of #268. #273's realistic fixtures/census, #272's selected toolchain and #271's routine reliability are complete and integrated. #274's remaining callers/contracts must be integrated before final campaign evidence. Begin execution design and a bounded accounting pilot now; do not rerun completed fixture construction.

Main `e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146` (PR #304), schema 32: [current-main CI 34552632337](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34552632337) passes all nine required jobs. Routine validation is green; extended journeys, full stress, accepted-tier capacity and live rollout remain separate evidence gates.

## First slice: supported workload arrangement and accounting pilot

- [ ] Prove independently complete bounded collection scopes can compose into the intended catalogue with stable identity, truthful coverage/carry-forward and recorded owner actions. Determine whether existing source selection supports the required segmentation; if not, specify and implement the smallest bounded extension before large execution.
- [ ] Use the actual request graph: tier 1 has 20,625 requests; tier 2 has 206,250. The fixture policy is 5,000 per run and the global ceiling is 25,000. A single oversized run cannot prove usable capacity; do not weaken guards merely to obtain a pass.
- [ ] Execute one small native end-to-end workload through publication and actual restore, measuring disjoint storage components. Establish machine/volume headroom before full execution: raw bodies alone are approximately 5.10 GiB / 51 GiB, excluding indexes, serving copies, history, concurrent work and restore staging.
- [ ] Retain the real-source limitations explicitly: P-001 is bounded overlapping One Piece coverage; Riftbound returns 1,189 records against 1,197 metadata and lacks retained bytes for 1,183 image URLs. Injected missing-image responses do not prove full-image capacity. Account for the declared scope and obtain an explicit scope/budget decision for any proposed change to accepted gates.

[Fixture/census and accounting handoff](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/blob/e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146/docs/validation/issue-273-fixtures-and-census.md). The September 11 audit passed eight generator/domain and two accounting checks; all retained-source census sections and existing tiers were unchanged, with only the new two-image routine fixture added to generated output.

`test:full` excludes extended real-source journeys and benchmarks. Select the relevant `one-piece-two-source` and `riftbound-catalogue` extended scenarios explicitly. A full-stress pass or a zero-capture tier-admission pass does not complete the original campaign acceptance below.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Exercise 128 images x 100 KiB and both full accepted tiers from #268. Distinguish completed usable capacity from explicit guard rejection; do not weaken guards to claim success.
- [ ] Measure increasing-page workloads at fixed page/batch/concurrency limits and the declared real One Piece two-source and Riftbound workloads.
- [ ] Record census/bytes, peak isolate working set, CPU/wall time, binding calls, D1 rows/index/write amplification, retained/concurrent occupancy and owner actions.
- [ ] Evaluate bounded whole-page HTML parsing and single-record reconstruction at accepted worst-case input/output expansion; preserve large text and field names without truncation.
- [ ] Resolve or explicitly retain the initial 64 MiB target. Structural slow-sink tests and sampled maxima do not establish continuous peaks.
- [ ] Derive cost/completion targets from the declared workload and measured evidence. Record adjustable-budget decisions and missing provider/billing dimensions honestly.
- [ ] Run large measurements with exclusive host resource ownership: other heavy suites/profile runs must not contaminate the measurement. Publish an exact-SHA evidence ledger.

## Working constraints
Start from verified current main, read AGENTS.md and CONTEXT.md, and preserve unrelated edits. Use the existing public/API or established runtime seams. Record the exact tested commit and any failures. This ticket does not authorize live provisioning, billing changes, deployment, destructive cleanup or Go-Live.

comments.body:
#274's final caller/contract migration is implemented in [PR #305](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/pull/305) at `ed163d4f50a2641dd3f76da045a8865337b8932c`, based on `e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146`. Integration and resulting-main validation remain pending.

The migrated **128 images × 100 KiB** case passes native preparation, exact whole-candidate publication, actual SQL backup/restore, immutable image lengths/digests and export IDs. Candidate metadata stays below 1 MiB with no image base64. Its isolated process took 26.67 seconds; the combined four-case run also passes it. This is a bounded local fixture result, not accepted-tier coverage, continuous peak memory, Worker CPU or provider billing evidence.

The **1,001-Product publication/export case** repeatedly exceeds its existing **120-second test deadline** after native switch and backup dispatch. Later Product restore/export assertions remain unverified. [Exact reproduction and raw evidence are tracked in #253](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/issues/253#issuecomment-5628853432); retain this separately from the existing 15,000 ms candidate performance assertion. No fixture, deadline, production guard, bucket topology or assertion was weakened.

[Immutable caller/assertion ledger](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/blob/ed163d4f50a2641dd3f76da045a8865337b8932c/docs/reviews/publication-caller-retirement-2026-09-11.md). Use this gap in the supported-workload/accounting pilot and final capacity disposition; the 5/50 GiB tiers, increasing-page workloads and declared real-source measurements remain this issue's separate acceptance.
